senses.sense_definition: An event, game, or performance that is sensationally exciting, intense, or highly successful.

examples.text: The championship basketball final was a real <w>barnburner</w> until the final buzzer sounded.
Critics agreed that the opening concert was an absolute <w>barnburner</w> of a show.

traits.comment: often used in sports or entertainment

senses.sense_definition: A person who sets fire to or burns down a barn.

examples.text: The farmer stayed awake at night hoping to catch the <w>barnburner</w> who had targeted the valley.
Local authorities arrested a suspected <w>barnburner</w> shortly after the wooden structure was destroyed.

senses.sense_definition: A strike-anywhere match that ignites from friction against any rough surface.

examples.text: He struck a <w>barnburner</w> against the wooden wall of the shed to light his lamp.
Before modern safety matches were invented, carrying a <w>barnburner</w> in your pocket carried some risk.

senses.sense_definition: A member of a radical faction of the Democratic Party in mid-nineteenth-century New York that opposed the expansion of slavery and corporate monopolies.

examples.text: As a dedicated <w>Barnburner</w>, he refused to support any compromise that would expand slavery westward.
The internal feud between the <w>Barnburner</w> faction and conservative rivals weakened the state party.
